currentParagraphText: “We came to help you,” she spoke in a soft voice. “We made the Simivitas retreat, and your kits are safe.”

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “We came to help you,” she spoke in a soft voice. “We made the Simivitas retreat, and your kits are safe.”
finalResult.nextParagraphText: The ferret understood her words and quickly moved toward the mound and entered it. Through his sphere, Jake saw the mother nervously approach the five sleeping kits, nudging them a little with her nose and rubbing her face all over them until satisfied. A few seconds later, she turned around and walked out of the mound again, all her aggressiveness gone as she regarded Jake and the two women.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: Its eyes darted around the battlefield, likely trying to get an understanding of what had happened. There were clear signs of fighting, and the ferret did look like it was about to attack Jake and the two women, but Keerla quickly raised her hands and motioned for them to back away from the mound.
